# ChatGPT Conversation Recovery Dynamics
> A sanitized client-side case study of conversation recovery failures, HTTP 429 dynamics, history-aware recovery state, and provider-friendly recovery design.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics
Project portal: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/
30-second brief: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/brief/
Reproduction guide: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/reproduce/
Evidence explorer: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/lab/
Glossary: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/glossary/

## Evidence boundary
Observed facts, recomputed quantities, model-supported claims, simulations, design proposals, weak external evidence, and unknowns are deliberately separated.
This project does not claim to identify OpenAI's internal root cause, production topology, exact rate-limit scope, capacity, or queue sizes.
Raw authenticated HAR files are not published.

## Core public results
- 108 paired observations: 48 Accessible, 60 Blocked, 0 mixed.
- Cycle law: Delta ~= 5.6164 + 0.9566 * service_time, R^2 ~= 0.99136.
- First Accessible observation after Blocked rebounded to Blocked in 8/8 observed reentry cases within this capture.
- History-aware H/E/B model improves within-capture fit versus first-order A/B.
- Local congestion simulations support duplicate suppression, cheap observation, start-anchored spacing, and provider-friendly recovery. These are not OpenAI production estimates.

## Terminology
B = Blocked.
E = first Accessible excursion after Blocked; human-facing label: Recovering / provisional recovery.
H = Healthy / established Accessible after stable confirmation.

## Safety
Do not use this repository to load-test production OpenAI services, generate synthetic retry storms, deliberately trigger 429s, or bypass rate limits.
Prefer passive observation of naturally occurring failures and local simulation.

Recover. Don't amplify.
Visualization != Evidence.


## Purrtocol side-study
Purrtocol is the project's Recovery Cat and an anthropomorphic error model for recovery systems.
Canonical design bible: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol/
Expansion side-study: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-expansion/
The expansion analysis is deliberately separate from the primary evidence base. Current selected commit-event fit: doubling time about 3.758 h; Hawkes branching ratio about 0.85 (subcritical); Earth saturation NOT YET OBSERVED.

Doomsday toy-model dashboard: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-doomsday/
Purrtocol concept registry: https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-expansion/concepts/
The doomsday page is a sensitivity/falsification toy model. Quadratic coupling and observation-hazard parameters are illustrative; planetary saturation forecast is NOT ESTABLISHED.
Concept-registry entries have status=concept with null timestamp/source_commit and are excluded from commit-time growth/Hawkes fits.
